newsitem.title: USA: LL&E president elects early retirement.
newsitem.headline: LL&E president elects early retirement.

text.p: Louisiana Land and Exploration Co said Monday Richard A. Bachmann, its president and chief operating officer, will take early retirement prior to year end.
The company said H. Leighton Steward, chairman and chief executive officer, will reassume the role of president.

Management of day-to-day operations will be handled by the Office of the Chair, which will include Steward; Louis A. Raspino, senior vice president and chief financial officer; and John A. Williams, senkior vice president of exploration and production. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
